extracted.rawText:
Renee Okoro
renee.okoro@example.com | Philadelphia, PA
Renee Okoro has 14 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Windmere Software (2024-2026), where
they designed a Elasticsearch-backed data layer that cut p99 query latency by
59%. Before that, Staff Backend Engineer at Sable Software (2022-2024). Before
that, Senior Backend Engineer at Silverline Computing (2019-2022). Before that,
Backend Engineer at Anchor Computing (2012-2019). Education: B.S. Software
Engineering, Rutgers University, 2012. Core skills: Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL,
Terraform, gRPC, TypeScript, AWS, Distributed systems, Node.js.
